MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition x RRP x access x texture. Coating tasks use QT x access x texture x substrate_type. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x dash(2.00) = 12.80x — extreme theoretical, unrealistic combination
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x sand(1.25) = 2.53x — within cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.20) x scaffold(1.60) x dash(2.00) x traditional(1.00) = 3.84x — within 4.0x cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x sand(1.25) x traditional(1.00) = 1.69x — comfortable

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x texture)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x texture x substrate_type)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough — no modifiers applied.

stucco_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net stucco wall field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours. Texture profile modifier (FAC_SCRP_TEXTURE_PROFILE) is a DUAL multiplier — applies to BOTH labor rates (SF/hr) and material coverage (SF/gal). RP rates calibrated from NC sibling (SF_STUCCO_EXT_NC_v1) with RP-specific adjustments: spray_backroll is PRIMARY method, condition-driven prep tasks are RP_NEW.

task_production_rates._note: Protection setup, fixture masking, vehicle/driveway protection (RP-specific), ground cover for scraping debris (RP-specific), spray equipment setup

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_LANDSCAPE (120 LF/hr). Ground-level task. Deploy tarps and plastic sheeting along house perimeter. ~30 sec per LF. RP emphasis: catches scraping debris and rinse water runoff in addition to overspray.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Coverage adequate along working elevation. Minor gaps acceptable if no spray overspray risk.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full perimeter coverage of plantings within spray drift zone (10-15 ft). Secure against wind.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete perimeter coverage secured at all edges. No gaps in protection.

task_production_rates.name: Walkway Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_HARDSCAPE_WALK (250 SF/hr). Ground-level task. Lay drop cloths and plastic on flat walkway surfaces. ~14 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Key areas covered. Minor gaps acceptable away from spray zone.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage of walkways within overspray zone.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage taped at edges. Non-slip canvas on crew traffic areas.

task_production_rates.name: Patio Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_HARDSCAPE_PATIO (250 SF/hr). Ground-level task. Lay drop cloths and plastic on flat patio surfaces. ~14 sec per SF.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Key areas covered. Minor gaps acceptable away from spray zone.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage of patios within overspray zone.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage taped at edges. Non-slip canvas on crew traffic areas.

task_production_rates.name: Light Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_FIXTURE (7 EA/hr). Ground-level task. Mask exterior light fixtures with plastic and stucco tape. ~8.5 min per fixture. Stucco tape required — standard blue tape does not adhere to textured stucco surfaces.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Fixtures covered. Plastic secure.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage with stucco tape sealed at edges. No exposed lens or fixture body.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage sealed at all edges. Stucco tape firmly adhered to textured surface. Double-check seal.

task_production_rates.name: HVAC Unit Cover
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_HVAC (2.5 EA/hr). Ground-level task. Cover HVAC condenser units with plastic sheeting and secure. ~24 min per unit.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Units covered. Plastic secure.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage secured. Air intake not blocked during non-spray periods.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Secure against wind. Verified no air intake obstruction.

task_production_rates.name: Vehicle/Driveway Overspray Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Deploy heavy plastic or canvas over driveway and vehicles near spray zone. ~18 sec per SF. RP-specific — occupied home during repaint has vehicles present. Slower than walkway protection (200 vs 250 SF/hr) due to vehicle contour draping and securing against wind. Canvas preferred on driveway (non-slip).

defect_tolerance.QT2: Driveway and vehicles within drift zone covered.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full coverage of driveway and all vehicles. Canvas on foot traffic areas. Secure against wind.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Canvas on all foot traffic. Vehicles fully draped and taped. Wind-secured at all edges.

task_production_rates.name: Ground Cover for Scraping Debris
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Deploy ground cover at base of walls to catch scraping debris. FAIR/POOR condition only. ~12 sec per SF of wall area (ground coverage proportional to wall SF). Faster than standard protection because simple ground lay without taping. Facilitates cleanup and RRP compliance if pre-1978.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Ground cover at base of scraping areas. Catches bulk of debris.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full ground cover extending 6 ft from wall base. Edges lapped or taped.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete ground cover extending 10 ft from wall. Edges sealed. RRP-compliant if applicable.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_SPRAY_SETUP (35 min). Set up airless sprayer, prime pump, install tip (517 for acrylic, 521-525 for elastomeric), install filter (60-mesh for acrylic, 30-mesh for elastomeric), test pattern on cardboard. RP note: verify tip wear from previous use — RP jobs run on existing equipment.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Equipment operational. Pattern adequate.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean pattern test. Correct tip for material. Pressure verified.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Clean pattern test on cardboard. Correct tip and filter for material type. Pressure set per TDS. Pattern verified for texture profile.

task_production_rates._note: RP-specific condition assessment and caulk assessment

task_production_rates.name: Condition Assessment per Elevation

QT2.notes: Visual inspection. Classify coating condition. Spot adhesion test.

QT3.notes: Full visual. ASTM D3359 adhesion test per elevation. Chalk rub test. Moisture probe at joints.

QT4.notes: Comprehensive assessment. ASTM D3359 at multiple points per elevation. Chalk rub, moisture probe, photo documentation. Written substrate state per elevation.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Fixed time PER ELEVATION — multiply by elevation count at runtime. QT2 quick visual, QT3 instrument-aided (adhesion + chalk + moisture), QT4 systematic with documentation. Determines substrate state classification that drives primer selection.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Condition classified per elevation. Major issues identified.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full assessment with test results documented. Substrate state assigned per elevation.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Comprehensive assessment with photo documentation. Written substrate state classification with supporting test data.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Joint Assessment per Elevation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Walk and inspect all stucco-to-trim joints, expansion joints, and penetration perimeters. ~18 sec per LF. 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol — trace water path at each joint. Classify as intact/cracked/failed. Determines caulk removal/replacement scope.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Major failed joints identified. Scope for replacement documented.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All joints classified. Failed and cracked joints documented for replacement.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete joint inventory. Classification with photo documentation. Written scope for removal and replacement.

task_production_rates._note: Crack assess FIRST, EIFS knock test, moisture test, wash (branched), mildew, efflorescence, scraping, degloss, chalk remediation, crack patch, surface patch, caulk remove/apply, EIFS insurance

task_production_rates.name: Crack Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_CRACK_ASSESS (45 min/elevation). FIRST task — assess all cracks BEFORE any other prep. >1/8 inch = HARD STOP requiring structural evaluation. Fixed time per elevation — multiply by elevation count at runtime.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Major cracks identified and documented. Structural referral if >1/8 inch.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All cracks mapped. Width measured. Pattern assessed (structural vs shrinkage). Photo documentation.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Comprehensive crack map with measurements. Pattern analysis. Photo documentation. Written referral for any structural concerns.

task_production_rates.name: EIFS Knock Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_EIFS_KNOCK_TEST (45 min/elevation). Systematically knock-test EIFS surfaces per elevation. Hollow sound = EPS delamination = HARD STOP. Fixed time per elevation. EIFS only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Spot-check knock test on key areas. Delamination flagged.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full elevation knock-test. All delamination areas marked. Refer delamination >1 SF for repair.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Systematic grid knock-test at 2 ft intervals. All delamination documented with photos. Written repair referral.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Content Testing
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_MOISTURE_TEST (45 min). Moisture meter testing at joints, failure areas, grade line. MC <12% required. RP adds testing at visible coating failure areas (blistering, peeling zones indicate possible moisture source).

defect_tolerance.QT2: Spot-check at obvious risk areas (grade, penetrations, failure zones).
defect_tolerance.QT3: Test at all penetrations, window sills, grade line, and coating failure areas. Document readings.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Systematic testing grid. All penetrations, window sills, grade line, failure areas, and discoloration. Written documentation.

task_production_rates.name: Pressure Wash — Traditional Stucco
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_PRESSURE_WASH (NC 500 SF/hr -> RP 450 SF/hr). RP is ~10% slower because existing coating debris requires more careful rinsing and additional passes. Pressure wash at 1500-3000 PSI. Remove dirt, loose paint, efflorescence. 24-48 hr dry time. Traditional stucco only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Loose material and dust removed. Surface ready for next prep step.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean surface free of dust, efflorescence, and loose material. Uniform appearance.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Thoroughly clean surface. No residual efflorescence. No loose material. Consistent surface profile.

task_production_rates.name: Low-Pressure Wash — EIFS
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_EIFS_WASH (275 SF/hr). Low-pressure wash <500 PSI. CRITICAL: high pressure damages EIFS acrylic finish coat. ~13 sec per SF. Slower than traditional wash. EIFS only. Texture modifier NOT applied — EIFS wash is pressure-limited not texture-limited.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Surface clean. No pressure damage to EIFS finish coat.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean surface. No pressure damage. Uniform appearance. Mildew areas retreated.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Thoroughly clean. No pressure damage. Verified no water intrusion at penetrations during wash.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew Eradication Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_MILDEW_TREAT (150 SF/hr). Apply bleach solution (1:3), dwell 15-20 min, scrub with stiff bristle brush, rinse. ~24 sec per SF of affected area. Rate applies to AFFECTED AREA only. Texture modifier NOT applied — mildew treatment is chemical dwell + scrub, not texture-dependent.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible mildew killed. Surface cleaned.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All mildew eradicated. No live growth remaining. Surface cleaned and rinsed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete eradication verified. Surrounding area treated preventively. Documentation of treatment areas.

task_production_rates.name: Efflorescence Treatment

QT2.notes: Light dry-brush removal only. No acid treatment.

QT3.notes: TSP wash and brush scrub. Light efflorescence.

QT4.notes: Acid wash (muriatic dilute) for moderate-to-heavy efflorescence. Neutralize, rinse thoroughly.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_EFFLORESCENCE_TREAT. Qt_scaled — already has tier-specific rates. Rate applies to AFFECTED AREA only. Traditional stucco only — EIFS does not produce efflorescence. Condition modifier NOT applied — efflorescence treatment intensity is already QT-driven.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Loose efflorescence removed. Surface paintable.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Efflorescence removed. Surface clean and dry. No white residue remaining.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete removal. Acid-treated areas neutralized and rinsed. pH verified before priming.

task_production_rates.name: Light Scraping and Feather Sanding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Scrape localized failing areas with carbide scraper. Feather-edge sand with 80-100 grit. ~36 sec per SF of affected area. FAIR condition only. Rate applies to affected area — typically 10-20% of total wall SF at FAIR condition. Texture modifier applies — deeper textures slow scraping.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Loose paint removed. Edges feathered.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All failing paint scraped. Edges feather-sanded smooth. No raised edges.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete scraping. Feathered transitions invisible at 3 ft. No loose or bridged paint remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Heavy Scraping and Feather Sanding
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Extensive scrape with carbide scraper on widespread failing/peeling paint. Feather-edge sand. ~72 sec per SF. POOR condition only. Rate applies to affected area — typically 30-60% of total wall SF at POOR condition. Texture modifier applies — dash texture scraping is extremely labor-intensive. Heavy scraping is 2x slower than light scraping.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Majority of loose paint removed. Major edges feathered.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All failing/peeling paint removed to firm substrate. Edges feather-sanded. Surface profile uniform.
defect_tolerance.QT4: 100% removal of failing paint. Feathered transitions seamless. No loose paint anywhere. Surface ready for primer.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss/Scuff Sand
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. 150-180 grit scuff or chemical deglosser on sound paint for adhesion. GOOD condition only — paint is sound but needs mechanical/chemical profile for new coating adhesion. ~18 sec per SF. Texture modifier applies — deeper textures slow sanding. GOOD condition = SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Glossy surfaces scuffed. Adhesion adequate.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All glossy surfaces deglossed. Uniform dull finish across treated areas.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete deglossing. Uniform profile. Cross-hatch adhesion test on representative areas.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Remediation Pre-Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Chemical chalk remover on moderate-to-heavy residual chalk after wash. SS_EXT_CHALKING surfaces. ~20 sec per SF. Applied after pressure wash — treats chalk that washing alone did not remove. Followed by chalk-binding primer (MOD_SCRP_PRIME). Texture modifier applies — deeper texture traps chalk.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Moderate chalk residue removed. Surface significantly cleaner.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Chalk residue removed to light level. White cloth test shows minimal transfer.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Chalk fully remediated. White cloth test shows no transfer. Surface ready for chalk-binding primer.

task_production_rates.name: Cosmetic Crack Patching
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_CRACK_PATCH (75 LF/hr). Fill cosmetic cracks <1/8 inch with elastomeric crack sealant. ~48 sec per LF. Texture modifier NOT applied — crack filling is linear work not texture-dependent. Manual capture LF from field measure.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible cracks filled. Sealant flush with surface.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All cosmetic cracks filled. Sealant tooled smooth. Flush with surrounding surface.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All cracks filled and tooled. Sealant blended with surrounding texture. No raised or sunken fill lines.

task_production_rates.name: Surface Patching and Texture Match
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_SURFACE_PATCH (75 SF/hr). Patch spalled or damaged stucco areas and match surrounding texture profile. ~48 sec per SF. Texture modifier applies — dash and lace texture matching is skill-intensive. Rate applies to affected area only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Patches secure and flush. Texture approximation acceptable.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Patches blended with surrounding texture. Good match.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Patches indistinguishable from surrounding texture at 3 ft. Exact texture match.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Failed Caulk
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Cut and remove failed caulk from stucco-to-trim joints. Clean joint faces. ~60 sec per LF. Slower than new caulk application because removal requires cutting/scraping old material from textured stucco joint without damaging stucco. Manual capture LF from field measure (subset of caulk assessment LF).

defect_tolerance.QT2: Failed caulk removed. Joint faces reasonably clean.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All failed caulk removed. Joint faces cleaned. No old caulk residue in joint.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete removal. Joint faces clean and dry. Ready for new caulk application. No stucco damage from removal.

task_production_rates.name: Apply New Caulk
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_CAULK_JOINTS (100 LF/hr). Polyurethane caulk at stucco-to-trim joints. ~36 sec per LF. 3-7 day cure before painting. In RP context, applies to joints classified as cracked/failed during caulk assessment.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Joints sealed. Caulk bead continuous.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Clean caulk bead. Tooled smooth. No gaps or voids.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Perfect caulk bead. Tooled smooth with consistent profile. No excess or deficiency.

task_production_rates.name: EIFS Insurance Verification
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_EIFS_INSURANCE_VERIFY (20 min). Verify CGL covers EIFS work or confirm EIFS-specific rider. Administrative gate. EIFS only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Insurance verified. Written confirmation on file.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Insurance verified. Written confirmation on file. Policy rider documented.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Insurance verified. Written confirmation on file. Policy rider documented. Copy retained in project file.

task_production_rates._note: State-driven primer: chalk-binding for CHALKING, alkali spot on bare traditional, stain-block for FAILING/PEELING, brush detail

task_production_rates.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Full-surface chalk-binding primer via spray+backroll. 325 SF/hr BASE on smooth (slightly slower than NC alkali primer 350 SF/hr because chalk-binding primer has heavier body for chalk penetration). Two-person crew. SS_EXT_CHALKING only. Texture DUAL modifier applies to both labor and material coverage.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage. Chalk sealed. No holidays.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. Back-roll ensures penetration into chalk residue and texture. No bare spots.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage with consistent mil build. Back-roll verified for complete chalk penetration. No holidays or thin spots.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Full-surface chalk-binding primer via roll. 185 SF/hr BASE on smooth (slightly slower than NC alkali roll 200 SF/hr — heavier body primer). Single worker. Heavy-nap roller (1-1/4 to 1-1/2 inch). SS_EXT_CHALKING only. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage. Chalk sealed.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. Thick nap ensures texture and chalk penetration. No bare spots.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage with consistent mil build. Every texture valley primed. Chalk fully sealed.

task_production_rates.name: Alkali-Resistant Spot Primer on Bare Stucco
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC alkali primer tasks. Spot prime only — brush application on exposed bare traditional stucco areas revealed after scraping. 80 SF/hr (slower than field prime because spot work requires cutting around existing coating edges). Rate applies to AFFECTED AREA only. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING + traditional_stucco. Texture modifier applies — deep texture slows brush detail.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Bare areas primed. No exposed stucco remaining.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All bare areas primed. Feathered overlap onto existing coating. No holidays.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete spot prime. Feathered 2 inches beyond bare area onto existing coating. No visible transition lines.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Full or spot acrylic stain-block primer for adhesion on failing/peeling substrates. 350 SF/hr BASE on smooth — same rate as NC alkali primer spray_backroll. Two-person crew. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING. Locks down remaining coating and provides adhesion bridge. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage over failing areas. No holidays.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. Back-roll ensures penetration. Stain-block verified on test patch.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage with consistent mil build. Complete stain block. No bleed-through at 24 hrs. Back-roll verified.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Full or spot acrylic stain-block primer via roll. 200 SF/hr BASE on smooth — same rate as NC alkali roll. Single worker. Heavy-nap roller. SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_PEELING. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Full coverage over failing areas.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. No bare spots in texture valleys. Stain-block verified.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage. Consistent mil build. Complete stain block. No bleed-through.

task_production_rates.name: RP Primer Brush Detail Work
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_PRIME_BRUSH_DETAIL (65 SF/hr). Brush primer into detail areas — around penetrations, at trim transitions, in tight corners, at grade line. All primer types. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Primer in all detail areas. No bare spots at transitions.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage in all detail areas. Clean cut lines at trim transitions.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Precise cut lines. No bleed onto adjacent trim.

task_production_rates._note: First finish coat: acrylic spray_backroll/roll, elastomeric spray_backroll/roll (traditional stucco only), brush detail

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish Coat 1 Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_SPRAY_BACKROLL_1 (137 SF/hr). Spray acrylic finish then immediately back-roll. BASE rate on smooth texture. Two-person crew. Spray/backroll coupling compliant. Texture DUAL modifier applies to both labor and material coverage.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Even coverage. Consistent color. Maintain wet edge.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage and color. Consistent roller texture. No lap marks. No sags or runs.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. Consistent color and texture. No visible pattern variation. No lap marks, sags, or runs.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish Coat 1 Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_ROLL_1 (112 SF/hr). Roll acrylic finish with heavy-nap roller. BASE rate on smooth texture. Single worker. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Even coverage. Consistent color.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. No lap marks. Consistent roller texture.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage and mil build. No lap marks. Consistent appearance.

task_production_rates.name: Elastomeric Finish Coat 1 Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ELASTO_SPRAY_BACKROLL_1 (90 SF/hr). Spray elastomeric then back-roll. ~65% of acrylic rate. Larger tips (521-525), coarser filters (30-mesh), higher pressure. Traditional stucco ONLY — PROHIBITED on EIFS. QT3+ only. Texture DUAL modifier applies. Substrate_type modifier NOT applied — task already gated to traditional stucco.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent mil build (10-12 mils DFT per coat). No pinholes. Maintain wet edge.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build verified with wet film gauge. No pinholes, sags, or curtaining. Consistent appearance. 10-12 mils DFT per coat.

task_production_rates.name: Elastomeric Finish Coat 1 Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ELASTO_ROLL_1 (75 SF/hr). Roll elastomeric with heavy-nap roller. ~65% of acrylic roll rate. Traditional stucco ONLY. QT3+ only. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent thickness. No pinholes.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. No pinholes or thin spots. Wet film gauge verification.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 Brush Detail
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_BRUSH_DETAIL_1 (45 SF/hr). Brush finish into detail areas. Both acrylic and elastomeric. Slowest application method — detail work only. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Coverage in all detail areas.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage. Clean cut lines. Blended with field application.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Precise cut lines. Seamless blend with field coat. No brush marks visible at 3 ft.

task_production_rates._note: Intercoat inspection, QT4-only sand and dust removal

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_INSPECT_INTERCOAT (25 min). Walk all elevations after first finish coat. Check for holidays, thin spots, lap marks, sags. QT3 visual scan; QT4 systematic with raking light. RP adds comparison to pre-existing condition photos from assessment.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Visual scan of all elevations. Major defects noted.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Systematic inspection with raking light. All defects documented. Photo documentation of areas requiring touch-up.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Light Sand (QT4)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_SAND_INTERCOAT (250 SF/hr). 220 grit light sand on anomalies only — do NOT sand entire textured surface. QT4 only. Texture modifier NOT applied — sanding is spot work on anomalies, not texture-dependent.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Anomalies sanded smooth. No deep scratches. Dust removed. Surface ready for coat 2.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Dust Removal (QT4)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_DUST_INTERCOAT (500 SF/hr). Tack cloth or vacuum dust removal after interstage sanding. QT4 only. Texture modifier NOT applied — dust removal is surface sweep not texture-dependent.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All sanding dust removed. Surface clean and dry. Ready for coat 2.

task_production_rates._note: Second finish coat (QT3/QT4). Same structure as coat 1.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish Coat 2 Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_SPRAY_BACKROLL_2 (137 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1 — sealed surface provides consistent absorption. Two-person crew. Final appearance coat. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage and color. No visible pattern at 6 ft. Final coat.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 3 ft. Final appearance coat. Consistent sheen.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish Coat 2 Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ACRYLIC_ROLL_2 (112 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1 roll. Sealed surface. Final coat. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. Consistent roller texture. Final coat.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage and mil build. No lap marks. Final coat.

task_production_rates.name: Elastomeric Finish Coat 2 Spray+Backroll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ELASTO_SPRAY_BACKROLL_2 (90 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1. First coat provides sealed surface. Final coat — verify cumulative DFT (20-30 mils). Traditional stucco ONLY. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Cumulative DFT target 20-24 mils. No pinholes. Final coat.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build. Cumulative DFT 24-30 mils verified with wet film gauge. No defects. Final coat.

task_production_rates.name: Elastomeric Finish Coat 2 Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_ELASTO_ROLL_2 (75 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1 roll. Traditional stucco ONLY. Final coat. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Even coverage. Cumulative DFT on target. No pinholes. Final coat.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform mil build verified. Cumulative DFT 24-30 mils. Final coat.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 Brush Detail
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC TSK_STCO_FINISH_BRUSH_DETAIL_2 (45 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1 brush detail. Final coat detail work. Texture DUAL modifier applies.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage. Clean cut lines. Blended with field coat. Final coat.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage. Precise cut lines. Seamless blend. No brush marks at 3 ft. Final coat.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection

QT2.notes: Ground-level walkthrough. Quick scan for obvious misses.

QT3.notes: Ground-level walkthrough at 6-10 ft viewing distance. Backlight check. Compare to pre-existing condition photos.

QT4.notes: Ground-level with binoculars for upper elevations. Raking light and backlight. For elastomeric: verify DFT documentation. Compare to pre-existing photos.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_FINAL_INSPECT. Same time ranges but RP adds comparison to pre-existing condition photos from assessment module. Stucco-specific: check texture consistency, coverage uniformity, crack patch blending.

defect_tolerance.QT2: No obvious misses or holidays visible from ground.
defect_tolerance.QT3: No defects visible at 6-10 ft from ground level. Backlight passes. Improvement vs pre-existing photos confirmed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: No defects visible at 6 ft with binoculars. Coverage uniform across all elevations. DFT verified for elastomeric. Documented improvement.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up

QT2.notes: Minimal touch-up. Fix obvious misses only.

QT3.notes: Fix all noted defects. Focus on holidays and crack patch areas.

QT4.notes: Fix every defect. Blend seamlessly. Focus on texture consistency, coverage uniformity, and feathered transition zones.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_TOUCHUP. Same rates. RP adds focus on feathered transition zones where scraping was performed (FAIR/POOR condition areas). Texture DUAL modifier applies. Rate per affected area SF — most total wall area passes without touch-up.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Obvious misses touched up.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All noted defects repaired. Crack patches blended. Feathered transitions invisible.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All defects repaired. Touch-ups blended seamlessly with surrounding texture and color. No visible transitions.

task_production_rates._note: Protection teardown, equipment cleanup, waste disposal, customer walkthrough

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_PROTECT_TEARDOWN (NC 30 min -> RP 35 min). RP adds 5 min for vehicle/driveway protection removal and ground cover for scraping debris collection. Includes: stucco tape, landscape tarps, hardscape covers, fixture bags, HVAC covers, vehicle draping, ground cover. Check for stucco tape adhesive residue.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All protection materials removed.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All materials removed. No tape residue. Check landscape and vehicles for overspray. Ground cover debris collected.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All materials removed. Tape residue checked and cleaned. All protected surfaces inspected. Vehicles verified clean.

task_production_rates.name: Equipment Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_TOOL_CLEAN (NC 25 min -> RP 30 min). RP adds time for cleaning scraping tools (carbide scrapers, wire brushes) in addition to spray equipment. Flush airless sprayer, clean tips and filters, clean roller frames, dispose saturated thick-nap covers. Elastomeric projects: add 10 min for heavy-body flush.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Equipment flushed and stored.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full flush. Tips and filters cleaned. Tip wear inspected. Roller covers disposed. Scraping tools cleaned.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Full flush cycle. Tips and filters cleaned and inspected. All tools ready for next use.

task_production_rates.name: Waste Disposal and Site Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_STCO_WASTE_DISPOSE (NC 20 min -> RP 25 min). RP adds scraping debris collection and disposal. Paint chips, caulk tubes, stucco tape, plastic, paint cans, roller covers. If pre-1978: RRP-compliant waste handling (separate from MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT HEPA task). Final site walkthrough.

defect_tolerance.QT2: All debris collected and disposed.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Site restored to pre-work condition. All materials removed. Scraping debris properly disposed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Site restored. All waste properly disposed including RRP-compliant if applicable. No evidence of work activity.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW task. Walk project with customer upon completion. Review each elevation. Show before/after comparison photos. Confirm satisfaction. Sign completion. RP-specific — NC new construction does not have customer on-site for comparison. ~30 min (midpoint of 20-40 min range).

defect_tolerance.QT2: Walk key elevations with customer. Confirm acceptance.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Walk all elevations. Show before/after photos. Confirm acceptance. Address any concerns.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Comprehensive walkthrough all elevations. Before/after documentation. Written acceptance. Warranty documentation provided.

task_production_rates._note: Shared EPA RRP module for pre-1978 buildings

task_production_rates.name: Lead Paint Screening
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. XRF or EPA-certified test kit screening of all surfaces to be disturbed. ~45 min per project (midpoint of 30-60 min). Lead-certified renovator required. Pre-1978 only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Testing completed. Results documented. Positive surfaces identified.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All surfaces tested and documented. Test results on file. Containment plan confirmed.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Comprehensive testing with photo documentation. Written containment plan. Results on file.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Deploy 6-mil poly containment extending 10 ft from building. Secure at edges. Close windows/doors within 20 ft. Warning signs posted. ~60 min per setup (midpoint of 45-90 min). Two-person crew for poly handling. Pre-1978 only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Containment in place. Poly secured. Signs posted.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete containment per EPA RRP Rule. Poly lapped and taped. Windows closed. Signs posted.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete containment per EPA RRP Rule. Documented with photos. All edges sealed. Windows verified closed. Signs posted.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Wet scraping of lead-containing paint. Mist surfaces to minimize dust. Collect all debris on containment poly. ~90 sec per SF. Much slower than standard scraping (50-100 SF/hr) due to wet method and careful debris containment. Pre-1978 only. Rate applies to area being disturbed.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Wet scraping completed. Debris contained on poly.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Wet scraping per RRP. All debris on containment. No visible dust generation.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Wet scraping per RRP with documentation. Zero visible dust. All debris contained and collected.

task_production_rates.name: RRP HEPA Vacuum
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. HEPA vacuum all surfaces within containment zone after wet scraping. ~24 sec per SF. Include window sills, ledges, and horizontal surfaces. Pre-1978 only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Surfaces vacuumed. Visible debris removed.
defect_tolerance.QT3: All surfaces HEPA vacuumed per RRP. No visible debris or dust.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete HEPA vacuum with EPA cleaning verification check. Documented.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Carefully fold containment poly inward (mist first). Seal in heavy-duty bags. Dispose per EPA hazardous waste requirements. ~45 min (midpoint of 30-60 min). Two-person crew. Pre-1978 only.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Containment removed. Waste bagged.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Containment folded inward per RRP. Waste double-bagged and labeled. Disposal documented.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Containment removal per EPA RRP. Waste properly sealed, labeled, disposed. Documentation complete with photos.

factor_modifiers.name: Stucco Texture Profile DUAL Modifier (Labor + Material)
factor_modifiers.description: DUAL modifier — applies to BOTH labor production rates (SF/hr) AND material coverage rates (SF/gal). Rougher textures slow production AND increase material consumption. This is the DOMINANT cost driver for stucco work. Identical values to NC sibling FAC_STCO_TEXTURE_PROFILE.
factor_modifiers.notes: Smooth is baseline (1.00x). Sand adds 25%. Lace adds 50%. Dash doubles both time and material. PRIMARY cost driver. Stacks with FAC_SCRP_SUBSTRATE_TYPE and FAC_EXT_ACCESS in coating pool, or with FAC_SCRP_CONDITION and FAC_EXT_ACCESS in prep pool. RP extends texture modifier to prep tasks (scraping, deglossing, chalk remediation, surface patch) — NC applied texture to coating tasks only.

factor_modifiers.name: Stucco Substrate Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: EIFS is smoother and less porous than traditional stucco — slightly faster coating application. Labor rate modifier ONLY — does not affect material coverage. Coating pool only.
factor_modifiers.notes: Traditional stucco is baseline. EIFS 10% faster (0.90 modifier). Labor ONLY. NOT applied to elastomeric tasks (already gated to traditional stucco). NOT applied to brush detail (too small area to matter). NOT applied to prep tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: RP Condition Scale Modifier (Prep Pool Only)
factor_modifiers.description: Condition scale drives prep task intensity. GOOD = minimal prep. FAIR = moderate scraping/patching. POOR = extensive scraping/patching. PREP POOL ONLY — NEVER applies to coating tasks.
factor_modifiers.notes: GOOD is baseline. FAIR adds 50% prep time. POOR doubles prep time. Applied ONLY to variable-rate prep tasks where condition directly affects scope. NOT applied to scraping tasks (already gated by condition_scale in applies_when). NOT applied to condition-gated tasks like degloss (GOOD only), chalk remediation (CHALKING only). NOT applied to crack/surface patch (fixed rate regardless of condition). NOT applied to caulk tasks (LF-based, condition-independent). NOT applied to assessment or coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: RRP Lead-Safe Protocol Modifier (Prep Pool Only)
factor_modifiers.description: Pre-1978 RRP protocols add time to prep tasks. Wet methods, containment management, and documentation overhead. PREP POOL ONLY.
factor_modifiers.notes: RRP doubles prep task time due to wet methods, containment checks, and documentation. Applied to wash and scrape tasks only — these are the tasks where RRP protocol adds significant time. Separate from MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT tasks (which have their own standalone rates). NOT applied to coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Height Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work. Applied per elevation. Shared across prep and coating pools.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applied per elevation. Protection setup/teardown, spray setup, assessment fixed tasks, tool cleaning, waste disposal, customer walkthrough, RRP containment setup/teardown are ground-level or administrative — not affected.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Modifier (Coating Pool Only)
factor_modifiers.description: QT affects coating pace. QT2 faster, QT4 slower. COATING POOL ONLY — applied to binary coating tasks only (qt_scaled/qt_conditional already have tier-specific rates).
factor_modifiers.notes: QT2 15% faster (economy). QT3 baseline. QT4 20% slower (premium scrutiny). Binary coating tasks only — qt_scaled tasks already encode tier differences. NEVER applied to prep tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Wind Condition Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Wind affects spray operations. High wind blocks spray entirely. Moderate wind slows spray work.
factor_modifiers.notes: High wind BLOCKS spray operations per SOP. Moderate wind 15% slower. Roll and brush not significantly affected. Spray tasks only.

factor_modifiers.name: Sun Exposure Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Full sun exposure causes flash drying. Stucco retains heat — surface temp can exceed air temp significantly.
factor_modifiers.notes: Full sun on stucco causes rapid surface heating and flash drying. Especially critical for elastomeric. Forces slower pace to maintain wet edge.

factor_modifiers.name: Surface Temperature Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Extreme surface temperatures affect coating application.
factor_modifiers.notes: Optimal: 50-90F surface temp. Cold (<50F): 10% slower. Hot (>90F): BLOCKED. Stucco retains heat longer than wood.

quality_effects.notes: Economy tier. Single finish coat acrylic. Prime if substrate state is not SOUND_PAINT (state-driven). No interstage module. Elastomeric NOT available at QT2.
Standard tier. Two finish coats (acrylic or elastomeric). Interstage inspection. Prime is state-driven. All coating systems available.
Premium tier. Two finish coats. Interstage sand on anomalies. State-driven primer. Systematic inspection with raking light.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: BEST CASE — Smooth traditional stucco, acrylic, ground, QT3, GOOD condition (spray_backroll)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Best case coating rate on traditional stucco.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Sand texture, traditional stucco, acrylic, ladder, QT3 (spray_backroll)
WORST CASE COATING — Dash texture, traditional, elastomeric, scaffold, QT4 (spray_backroll)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Near 4.0x cap (3.84x). 90 / 3.84 = 23 SF/hr per 2-person crew. Extremely slow — flag for estimator review.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: WORST CASE PREP — Heavy scrape, POOR condition, RRP, scaffold, dash texture
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Heavy scraping at worst conditions. 50 / 3.20 = 16 SF/hr. Note: condition and RRP modifiers NOT applied to scraping tasks (already gated by condition_scale). Extreme but realistic for damaged dash stucco on upper stories.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Pressure wash, POOR condition, RRP, ladder, sand texture (traditional stucco)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Extreme prep scenario. 450 / 6.75 = 67 SF/hr. RRP + POOR condition + ladder + sand. Prep pool can exceed 4.0x cap — flag for estimator review on extreme combinations.

assumptions: Base rates for spray_backroll are per crew-hour with 2 workers (sprayer + roller). crew_size = 2.
Base rates for roll and brush are per single worker. crew_size = 1.
Spray/backroll coupling rule satisfied on all spray_backroll tasks.
FAC_SCRP_TEXTURE_PROFILE is a DUAL modifier — applied to BOTH labor rates (SF/hr) and material coverage (SF/gal). Unique to stucco.
FAC_SCRP_SUBSTRATE_TYPE applies to LABOR rate only — NOT material coverage.
Elastomeric base rates (~65% of acrylic) already account for heavier body — no separate coating_system modifier needed.
Modifier stacking is multiplicative within each pool. Prep pool and coating pool NEVER cross.
Maximum combined COATING modifier: 3.84x (dash 2.00 x scaffold 1.60 x QT4 1.20). Under 4.0x cap.
PREP pool can exceed 4.0x in extreme combinations (condition x RRP x access x texture). Flag for estimator review.
RP primer selection is STATE-DRIVEN (not substrate-driven as in NC): chalk-binding for CHALKING, stain-block for FAILING/PEELING, alkali spot on bare traditional stucco.
SOUND_PAINT (GOOD condition) skips prime module entirely — verified adhesion means direct-to-finish.
Finish coat rates transfer DIRECTLY from NC — same products, same application technique.
RP-specific prep tasks (scraping, deglossing, chalk remediation, condition assessment) are RP_NEW with calibrated rates.
RRP module tasks have standalone rates — not affected by stacking modifiers.
Environmental modifiers (wind, sun, surface temp) apply to coating tasks only, consistent with NC sibling.
risks: Dash texture + elastomeric + scaffold + QT4 is near 4.0x coating cap (3.84x) — flag for estimator review.
DUAL texture modifier on material coverage is critical — dash uses 2x material vs smooth. Under-estimation risk.
Prep pool extreme combinations (POOR + RRP + scaffold + dash) can reach 6-8x — these are RARE but must be handled.
EIFS knock test may reveal delamination requiring repair — blocks project. Scheduling risk.
Moisture behind EIFS is catastrophic — coating over moisture leads to blistering and structural damage.
Crack width >1/8 inch is HARD STOP — structural evaluation required.
Stucco tape adhesive residue on multi-day exterior projects.
RP chalk remediation efficacy varies — some chalk cannot be fully removed and requires chalk-binding primer.
Heavy scraping on POOR condition stucco may reveal more bare area than estimated — primer quantity may increase.
Customer walkthrough (RP-specific) may identify additional touch-up scope.
RRP wet scraping at 40 SF/hr on large POOR condition walls creates significant labor cost — flag projects with >1000 SF POOR + pre-1978.
validation_plan: Time 3 RP acrylic spray_backroll finish projects on smooth traditional stucco at ground to validate 137 SF/hr baseline transfers from NC.
Time 2 RP elastomeric spray_backroll projects to validate 90 SF/hr baseline transfers.
Compare RP pressure wash rates to NC rates to validate 10% slower (450 vs 500 SF/hr).
Time light scraping on FAIR condition stucco to calibrate 100 SF/hr baseline.
Time heavy scraping on POOR condition stucco to calibrate 50 SF/hr baseline.
Track chalk-binding primer application rate to validate 325 SF/hr spray_backroll.
Track stain-block primer application rate to validate 350 SF/hr spray_backroll.
Time condition assessment across 3 projects to validate QT3 45 min/elevation.
Track caulk removal rates to validate 60 LF/hr (slower than new application 100 LF/hr).
Time customer walkthrough across 5 projects to validate 30 min baseline.
Compare RP protection teardown time to NC to validate +5 min adjustment (35 vs 30 min).
Track material consumption on dash texture RP projects to validate 2.0x DUAL texture modifier on coverage.
